notes.title: Major Update Sneak Peek #2: A Closer Look at Our New Monsters!
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We want to start by saying thank you for the incredible support and passion you've shown for I Am Legion: Stand Survivor. Fueled by your enthusiasm, we’ve decided to do something huge: [b]We're tearing it all down to rebuild it, better than ever![/b]

To be clear, this isn't just a patch with a few tweaks. We are fundamentally reforging the gameplay from the ground up. Our goal is to break free from the old constraints and deliver a new experience that's [b]richer, deeper, and packed with surprises.[/b]

In our first preview, we talked about our new direction. Now, in Part 2, we’re excited to finally dive into the details! We believe every monster should feel unique, with its own attacks and strategies, making every battle an intense, unpredictable thrill. We’ve even got some GIFs ready to show you what we mean! 🐉💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147168/543d76f76ca6c580ceb2a44097920ed742cbde3d.gif[/img]

Right now, we're planning to unleash over [b]20 brand-new monsters[/b] in the update (the final number might change a bit at launch), and that's just for starters!

We'll be pulling back the curtain on even more massive features in the announcements to come. So stay tuned, and be sure to join our official community to share your ideas and let us know what you're excited for!

[h3]Highlights of the Major Update:[/h3]

- [b]Artifact System:[/b] Nearly 200+ brand-new Artifacts! They will completely replace the old equipment system, bringing in a new synthesis mechanic with powerful synergy effects. Expect more than just stat boosts—these artifacts will grant new active and passive skills to completely change the way you fight.

- [b]Awakening for Purple Stands: [/b]All Purple-rarity Stands will now have an Awakening! Unleash their true potential and push your power to incredible new heights.

- [b]A Host of New Enemies: [/b]Prepare to face threats you've never seen before and experience a whole new level of challenge and excitement.

- [b]More Blessings: [/b]We're adding entire new systems for Blessings, opening up a world of strategic choices for you to craft the perfect build.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109580/_/

notes.title: 🔥New Version Update | Endless Mode Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
Dear Warriors! Great news! After a period of dedicated preparation, "I Am Legion: Stand Survivors" welcomes a brand new version! This update is packed with exciting content, and we invite you all to dive in and check it out!

Huge thanks for sticking with us and being so patient! Alright, let's dive into the juicy details:

[h3]Endless Mode is Now Live![/h3]

Achieve a 3-star rating on any stage to unlock Endless Mode. Challenge your limits in perpetual combat! How long can you survive?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147168/59384e57d196d0012f5d1ba9aa2aaac1f1194af4.png[/img]

[h3]Loads More New Stuff![/h3]

- Added new Talent Warfare Expansion: Gear Expansion (New Equipment Slot), Forbidden Contract (Stand Ban), Immortality (Resurrection).
- The 'Reforge Master' Talent has been changed to add one more reforge option, while also reducing the requirement for Ancient Leaves.
- Added a new special attribute for Red Equipment - Attack Speed.
- Added the Red Equipment Enhancement function (Identical Red Equipment can be used for enhancement).
- Added Purple Anvil spawns.
- Added 6 Package Slots.
- Added the function to continuously exchange Talent Points by holding down the button.
- Added damage statistics for the last 1 minute, switchable via hotkey on the page.
- The Gold threshold for the 'Tycoon' skill has been changed from 8000 to 10000.
- Added a health bar easing effect for normal monsters.
- Added icon indicators for Blessings not yet obtained in the Glossary.
- The in-game Stand Glossary will now mark missing green-rarity Stand materials for set targets (to assist when considering Stand bans).

[h3]Adjustments & Optimizations[/h3]

- Optimized save backup: The backup timing has been changed from every time the game starts to after each game round ends.
- Equipment Reforge now defaults to offering 2 choices (pick 1), and the Gold cost for equipment rerforging has been increased.
- Reduced the Talent Point cost for Gold Growth and Ore Growth talents.
- Werewolf's skill description removed the '(Unique Effect)' tag; the conversion changed from 5 Max HP for 1 Physical Attack & Magic Power to now requiring 8 Max HP for 1 Physical Attack & Magic Power.
- Increased spawn cap changed from 200 to 350.
- 'Beast Tamer' name changed to 'Magician'; skill changed from +5 Magic Power to +6 Magic Power.
- When switching the language to German, the Z hotkey will automatically change to the Y hotkey.
- Strengthened the attribute growth for Moon Goddess and Swordsman.

[h3]Bug Squashing![/h3]

- Fixed an issue with incorrect priority in Stand combination recipes.
- Fixed a bug where Stand transparency settings did not affect Zhao Yun's skill.
- Modified the recycling prices for equipment.
- Fixed description errors for the Chanting skills of Monk and Buddha.

notes.title: Thank you and new version update is now live
notes.notes:
First and foremost, we sincerely appreciate all your support and feedback! We have carefully reviewed and collected every suggestion you’ve provided. I am working tirelessly to address the issues, and I kindly ask for your patience as we continue optimizing and adjusting the game.

To tackle some of the key issues raised by players, we have rolled out a priority update today with the following improvements:

[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased character experience gain and overall emerald drops from 100% to 300%.
[*] Added extra character experience rewards and emerald drops after winning a game.
[*] Extended BOSS challenge time（First BOSS: 3:30 → 4:00、Second BOSS: 3:00 → 4:00）
[*] Reduced the number of emeralds required for talent leaf exchange
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Stand recipes would not automatically unlock in the recipe guide after crafting.
[*] Fixed English text description of Vampire level 9 skill
[/list]

As an indie game developed by just two people, we are working hard to fine-tune the game and fix bugs. We greatly appreciate your patience and continued support! We will actively gather your feedback to make the game even better.

If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam! If you have any suggestions, feel free to [url=https://wj.qq.com/s2/18561750/ixx6/]share them here[/url]—we will prioritize addressing them as quickly as possible.

notes.title: 🔥Steam Next Fest Demo Now Live! Progress Transfers to Full Release
notes.notes:
Dear Warriors,

I Am Legion: Stand Survivors Next Fest demo is now available! I’m thrilled to announce the game’s official Steam launch on March 7th! This update incorporates player sugesstions and feedback to refine gameplay with optimizations and adjustments. I hope these newly added features and improvements will bring everyone richer enjoyment and more engaging challenges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147168/74455bdf4710f5a88726a0060e7974616df3e5b9.png[/img]

[h1]Let’s dive into the changes:[/h1]

[h2]Key Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overhauled Stands synthesis paths and numerical balancing in game (Stands Gallery must be re-unlocked)
(Next Fest demo progress fully transfers to full release, while older demo only retains character’s EXP and Emerald)
[*] Added 2 new blue-tier Stands
[*] Added EXP sharing system for characters
[*] Added hold-to-forge and batch forging shortcuts
[*] Added Stands Gallery shortcut in Stands Recruitment interface
[*] Added brief display for gaining Emerads during combat
[*] Added ally effects transparency settings
[*] Added a setting option for double-click to exit in special UIs (Stands Recruitment/Equipment interface)
[/list]
[h2]Optimizations/Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Extended the first boss’s time limit from 3m to 3m30s
[*] Fixed Stands pop-ups in Recruitment interface occasionally failing to close
[*] Fixed battlefield hearts sometimes can not be obtained
[*] Fixed enemies sometimes escape room boundaries
[*] Added "Confirm" button for direct Stands synthesis when conditions are met
[*] Added "Any button to exit" after synthesising
[/list]
[h2]⏳Officially released on steam on March 7th, adding to wishlist now!⏳[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109580/_/

As an independent game developer, I sincerely appreciate your continued support and love for my game. If you have any suggestions or ideas, please join our community to share them with me. Additionally, if you encounter any issues while playing, please also connect with me through the community. This will allow me to address your concerns more promptly and effectively.
Happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo Update - November
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

Thank you all for your ongoing support! In this demo update, we've optimized and adjusted several features based on your feedback to bring you a richer and more challenging gaming experience. We hope these new features and improvements make your journey even more exciting! Here are the details of this update:

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added language options (German, Russian, Spanish-Latin America, French, Portuguese-Brazil, Turkish)
[*]Added display of doors on the mini-map
[*]Added prompt when enough coins are available to unlock doors
[*]Added display of game end time after a battle
[*]Added support for scrolling damage statistics with the right stick on the gamepad (up and down)
[/list]
(If you encounter any translation-related issues during the game, please join our community and let us know)

[h2]Optimizations and Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the display of critical hit values in the attribute page from the final value to the incremental value, with the final value displayed in the stand-in details page
[*]Fixed a bug where the refresh button on the stand-in recruitment page could not be clicked with the mouse under certain circumstances
[*]Fixed a bug where the stand-in statistics page overlapped on the battle end page
[*]Adjusted the display format of some long numbers
[/list]

The game is still in development. If you enjoy it, please add it to your Steam wishlist. Meanwhile, join our community to share your thoughts and suggestions. I'm looking forward to talking with you again. Thanks again for your support!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo Update-Sep 16
notes.notes:

[h3]New Additions[/h3]

- Added support for Traditional Chinese
- Added visibility settings for “stands"
- Added a minimap feature
- Added equipment reforging functionality
- Added a hotkey for talent exchange
- Added the display of current map difficulty in the battle result screen
- Changed skill cooldown description to skill cooldown speed (can exceed 100%, for example, a 10-second cooldown skill will become 5 seconds with 100% cooldown speed)
- Added a bleeding effect to the Great Sage's skill
- When using a game controller, the mouse will automatically hide

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]

- Optimized auto equipment synthesis, prioritizing slots in the equipment bar

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]

- Changed the skill cooldown display to reflect cooldown speed
- Updated some text descriptions (e.g., idle gold, idle physical attack)

If you enjoy this game, please add it to your Steam wishlist. Also, feel free to join the community to share your thoughts and ideas—I’m looking forward to discussing them with you directly. Thank you again for your support!
